items.body_excerpt:
Ron Harper Jr. was a bright spot in the Celtics' loss to the Warriors.

There's a lot that goes into managing a rotation, but there's now a pathway to getting him playing time: hardwoodhoudini.com/its-time-cel...

media.title: It's time for the Celtics to give Ron Harper Jr. more minutes
media.description: Ron Harper Jr. is a dynamic talent at both ends of the floor. The Celtics now have a clear path to give him more playing time.

items.title: Good minutes from Ron Harper Jr. He's playing with good energy on both ends of the floor. Boston needs that right now.

items.title: Spent the first half wondering if the Celtics would turn to Ron Harper Jr.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Spent the first half wondering if the Celtics would turn to Ron Harper Jr. 

Even w/o Paul George, they still have a ton of wings who should have fresh enough legs based on minutes played yesterday in Orlando.

But this is also Celtics' 3rd game in 4 days. Glad to see RHJ get an opportunity here.
